verdict.rationale: An identity-verification SaaS with a dashboard could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents none: the MCP server is a tool for external agents to call the Stripe API, and the fraud detection and manual review tools are adjacent features, not AI-generated insights or suggestions shown to the user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
